title: Submit a borrow request and receive a tracking ID
description: Verifies an authenticated borrower can create and submit a borrow request and is shown a success page containing a Tracking ID.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /borrow.html
Select a valid start date
Select a valid end date after the start date
Search for an equipment item that is available for the selected date range
Add the equipment item to the cart
Set the cart quantity to 1
Fill in the required borrower information fields with valid values
Submit the borrow request
Verify the user lands on the submission success page
Verify a Tracking ID is displayed

title: Approve a pending borrow request
description: Verifies an admin can review a pending request, approve it with a note, and the request reflects an approved status in the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/index.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the admin login form
Click to open the admin dashboard
Open the details for a pending borrow request
Fill an approval note into the approval note field
Approve the request
Verify the request shows an approved status in the admin dashboard

title: Look up a request by Tracking ID and view details
description: Verifies a public user can search by Tracking ID and view the request status and item details.
category: Tracking Lookup and Cancel Pending Request

steps.description: Navigate to /tracking.html
Enter a Tracking ID obtained from a newly submitted request
Submit the tracking search
Verify request status details are displayed
Verify the requested item list is displayed

title: Enforce availability when cart quantity exceeds available inventory
description: Verifies the borrower cannot submit a request when any cart item quantity exceeds availability for the selected date range and is prompted to adjust quantities.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /borrow.html
Select a valid start date
Select a valid end date after the start date
Search for an equipment item that shows limited availability for the selected date range
Add the equipment item to the cart
Increase the cart quantity to a value greater than the shown available quantity
Fill in the required borrower information fields with valid values
Submit the borrow request
Verify an availability or quantity validation error is visible
Verify the user remains on the borrow request page

title: Reject a borrow request with a reason
description: Verifies an admin can reject a request by providing a rejection reason and the request reflects a rejected status in the dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/index.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the admin login form
Click to open the admin dashboard
Open the details for a request under review
Fill a rejection reason into the rejection reason field
Reject the request
Verify the request shows a rejected status in the admin dashboard

title: Record per-item return outcomes for a request
description: Verifies an admin can record return outcomes per item on a request and the recorded outcomes appear in the request history view.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/index.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the admin login form
Click to open the admin dashboard
Open the details for a request eligible for return processing
Set at least one item outcome to returned
Set at least one item outcome to returned_pending_inspection or damaged
Save the return outcomes
Verify the request shows recorded return outcomes in its history/details view

title: Cancel a pending request from tracking view
description: Verifies a user can cancel a request when its status is pending and sees confirmation that cancellation was submitted.
category: Tracking Lookup and Cancel Pending Request

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /borrow.html
Select a valid start date
Select a valid end date after the start date
Search for an available equipment item and add it to the cart with quantity 1
Fill in the required borrower information fields with valid values
Submit the borrow request
Click the link to track the submitted request
Initiate cancellation for the pending request
Confirm cancellation in the cancellation dialog
Verify a cancellation submitted confirmation is visible
Verify the request status indicates cancellation is in effect or pending cancellation

title: View borrower request history and jump to tracking details
description: Verifies an authenticated borrower can view recent requests in history and open a request to jump to its tracking details.

Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /history.html
Open details for a request in the recent history list
Click the control to view tracking details for the selected request
Verify the user lands on the tracking page for the selected request
Verify request status details are displayed

title: Persist moderation status change after page refresh
description: Verifies that after approving or rejecting a request, reloading the dashboard still shows the updated status for that request.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/index.html
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the admin login form
Click to open the admin dashboard
Open the details for a pending borrow request
Fill an approval note into the approval note field
Approve the request
Reload the page
Verify the same request still shows an approved status in the admin dashboard

title: History details show dates, items, and current status for a selected request

title: Prevent rejecting without a rejection reason
description: Verifies attempting to reject a request without providing a rejection reason is blocked and the request is not rejected.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/index.html

Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the admin login form
Click to open the admin dashboard
Open the details for a request under review
Clear the rejection reason field
Attempt to reject the request
Verify a rejection validation error is visible and the request remains not rejected

description: Verifies attempting to approve a request without required approval details is blocked and the request is not approved.

steps.description: Navigate to /admin/index.html

title: Block cancellation when request status is not pending
description: Verifies that when a request is not pending, the UI prevents cancellation and explains that cancellation is not allowed for the current status.
category: Tracking Lookup and Cancel Pending Request

Enter a Tracking ID for a request that is in a non-pending status
Submit the tracking search
Attempt to initiate cancellation
Verify an explanation is visible that cancellation is not allowed for the current status
Verify the request status remains unchanged on the page
